item.text: {"0":"Across all four datasets, jointly set NUM_BLOCKS=8, DROPOUT_RATE=0.2 and LR=1e-3, retaining MAXLEN=64 and hidden size 64. Greater convolution depth may improve context processing, with stronger dropout controlling added capacity and the higher learning rate accelerating fitting. Preserve existing prefix-length features, embedding design, readout, pointwise loss and optimizer type. Keep one model per category, fixed seeds, 200 batches per epoch and the 200-epoch cap; synchronize checkpoint metadata and predictor construction.","1":"Across all four datasets, index positional embeddings by cumulative nonpadding count rather than absolute padded-array position: pos=(seq!=0).cumsum(1)*(seq!=0). This aligns the same observed-prefix length across training and inference, potentially reducing positional mismatch for short histories. Retain MAXLEN=64, the existing prefix-length feature, causal convolution topology, final-real-position readout, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer. Apply identical position construction in the predictor writer; retain one checkpoint per category.","2":"Across all four datasets, construct f_i=log1p(training_count_i)/max_j log1p(training_count_j) using training interactions only. Multiply historical item embeddings by 1-0.3*f_i before adding the unchanged positional and prefix-length contributions; keep padding zero and candidate embeddings unchanged. This fixed input feature may reduce common-item dominance alongside the current pointwise loss. Preserve learned embedding design, backbone topology, readout, loss and optimizer. Store frequency values as checkpoint buffers and reproduce the transformation through the predictor writer, with one model per category.","3":"Across all four datasets, change only loss weighting: compute the existing softplus(-positive_score)+softplus(negative_score) mean separately over each sequence's valid target positions, then average over nonempty sequences. The current global position mean gives longer histories greater weight; equal sequence weighting may better match evaluation's equal weighting of users, given median histories of 7–8 interactions. Preserve sampling, features, embeddings, causal backbone, scoring/readout, optimizer, scheduler and training limits. Prediction remains unchanged, using one checkpoint per category."}
